considered_statement: Although PKD1 and PKD2 cause a similar phenotype, PKD1 variants are associated with more severe disease and earlier ESRD (around age 53), compared to PKD2 mutations, in which the disease progression is less severe, with fewer renal cysts, and late-onset hypertension and ESRD (around age 72) [ 71 , 72 , 73 ].
exclusion_reason: the retrievable OA disease-level severity framing for polycystic kidney disease 2 (PKD2-gene ADPKD, C2751306) is COMPARATIVE -- 'PKD1 variants are associated with more severe disease and earlier ESRD (around age 53), compared to PKD2 mutations, in which the disease progression is less severe' frames PKD2's magnitude only RELATIVE to PKD1 (PKD2 = the milder, later-ESRD form of ADPKD), using 'more severe' / 'less severe' as a between-genotype contrast rather than a clean disease-level magnitude for PKD2's own dominant untreated sequela (progressive cystic kidney enlargement to end-stage renal disease); the frozen R3 severity function does not even pattern-match this (its 'severe' tier is blocked by the 'more '/'less ' negative lookbehinds), and no non-comparative disease-level PKD2 magnitude is retrievable; S left [H], not lifted

considered_statement: The phenotypes of these 17 OI patients varied widely, ranging from moderate (multiple fractures with progressive skeletal deformities) to mild (variable number of fractures with minimal skeletal deformities).
exclusion_reason: the retrievable OA progression framing for osteogenesis imperfecta (C0029434) is a within-entity SPECTRUM -- 'The phenotypes of these 17 OI patients varied widely, ranging from moderate (multiple fractures with progressive skeletal deformities) to mild (variable number of fractures with minimal skeletal deformities)' -- in which 'progressive' attaches only to the MODERATE Sillence sub-form inside a cohort that varies widely from moderate to mild, not to the OI entity itself; OI's dominant untreated sequela is heritable bone fragility / recurrent fractures (a fragility disorder, not a disease-level progressive entity), and 'progressive deformity' is a feature of the severe/moderate Sillence types only; although the frozen R3 progression function pattern-matches 'progressive' to tier 0.50 and the R3 spectrum override does not trip (no fatal-pole marker), the statement is a Sillence-type-stratified spectrum/form-specific description, not an isolable disease-level progression magnitude; P left [H], not lifted
